scope: Additive persistent outfit backend/API using existing app queue and storage; editor/renderer UI integration follows separately.

checks: Existing real app reward/calendar APIs verify two synthetic custom goals from four completed weekly measurements; no reward API stubs
Real IndexedDB save changes only outfit/recovery fields; stable custom IDs, shared artwork, body/order/visibility and legacy data retained
Reload through normal app initialization restores exact selection and recovery from real IndexedDB without seeding or migrating old fields
Actual JSON backup button exports new outfit/recovery and original application data
Actual backup import rejects damaged outfit structure before replacing any state
Confirmed actual backup import preserves new fields and unrelated synthetic records
Stale draft profile is rejected without modifying memory/disk or locking valid storage
Unowned catalogue try-on cannot be saved using the real reward evidence
Ordinary snapshot queued before outfit commit is rebased only for owned fields and cannot erase saved outfit
Fresh offline page loads via real worker, reopens draft, saves, reloads and durably rolls back using real IndexedDB
Real IndexedDB revision CAS rejects stale tab; winner remains on disk and failed outfit change rolls back in loser memory
Durable field-scoped rollback after later notes/checks preserves all later unrelated data and consumes exactly one recovery step
Actual IndexedDB put failure aborts transaction, rolls back outfit memory and leaves original disk state unchanged

storageRules: No auto-seeding/migration of old profiles or silent rewriting of legacy equipment, favorites/history, unknown data or goals/training
Exact current source profile required; actual fresh owned/allowed checks, never trusted preview evidence
Existing saved unresolved/resting requests retained but not rendered without fresh evidence; hiding retained entries allowed
Single durable field-scoped recovery survives reload and is consumed after rollback; does not rewind later notes/checks/workouts
Existing IndexedDB transaction revision CAS; fallback same Web Lock and exact previous raw record
Same app saveQueue; ordinary queued snapshots rebase only outfit-owned fields after outfit mutations
Write failure rolls back only owned memory fields, keeps disk original and locks further writes
Unknown future versions remain opaque and cannot be downgraded via editing or mixed-version recovery
Actual JSON backup/import validates current and historical extension; no new field on legacy validation/migration
Four explicit synthetic weekly measurements per custom goal exercise actual calendar/reward APIs, no browser tier/evidence stubs
limits: Random loopback origin and fresh browser context: never uses a deployed app or personal browser profile.
Backend/API contract only: existing legacy avatar renderer remains active; editor-to-profile UI integration is next.
Real Chromium IndexedDB/worker/offline checks are not physical iPhone/VoiceOver/old-installed-PWA acceptance.
Snapshot adapter has explicit 200000-value / 64-depth copy guard and 500-instance preview guard; failures do not truncate data.
Only one durable recovery step; full editor Undo/Redo remains session-only.
Stored request still requires legacy renderer; no final premium art, old-app UI semantics synchronization or complete new renderer integration yet.
